Git processes started during each scenario, issue #3677.

Lab: a scratch OpenChamber server (dev web HMR, API 3931, UI 5211) under a scratch
HOME, with a `git` wrapper first in its PATH and in the scratch .zshrc that logs
every call with its parent process. Six scratch repositories r1..r6 added as
projects (r7 added later, so the sidebar runs had 7). Headless Chrome over CDP.
The agent turn uses a local stub model that answers with 2 steps of 3 parallel
`write` calls each (6 files written), then "Done.". OpenCode's own git calls
(its snapshots, parent `opencode`) are counted apart: they are the same on both
builds and this change does not touch them.

"main" = the branch base (f3a3a01e7), "fix" = this branch, same server, same
page state, the changed files swapped in and the page reloaded between runs.

Scenario                                      main                 fix
--------------------------------------------  -------------------  -------------------
Two collapse/expand clicks on project r3,     110 (6 projects)     0
3 s apart, statuses older than 5 s            119, 116 (7)         0, 4 (*)
  status requests from the page               7                    0

Agent turn, 6 file writes, session open       98, 97 (37 once)     37, 18, 17
  status requests from the page               6, 6 (2 once)        2, 1, 1

New session from the CLI in r1                55                   26
  (session-created event)                     worktree listing     worktree listing
                                              of all 6 projects    of r1 only, plus
                                                                   one status read of
                                                                   the open project

New session from the CLI in r1, after the     not measured         9: worktree listing
review fix (UI not on r1)                                          of r1 only

New session from the CLI in a new worktree    not measured         listed r1 twice (the
of r1 (`--worktree wt-a`), which lives under                       server's worktree-changed
the registered `~` folder                                          and the session event);
                                                                   the session shows under
                                                                   r1 > openchamber/wt-a

Idle, 60 s                                    0                    0

Add project r7                                not measured         status read for r7
                                                                   only; worktree
                                                                   listing still runs
                                                                   for every project
                                                                   (unchanged)

Reload the page                               not measured         every project's
                                                                   status read once

(*) 4 = one `/api/git/branches` read of the open project, which also shows
up on main (main-3 run). The branch list refreshes itself after 30 s; the
sidebar did not start it.

Per status read the server starts about 17 git processes in these repositories
(rev-parse x7, status, diff --cached, diff-files, symbolic-ref, remote get-url,
rev-parse MERGE_HEAD, ...).
